name: Orki USD
oneLiner: USDK is Orki's Liquity v2-style CDP stablecoin on Swellchain, minted against WETH, weETH, rswETH, and swETH; SWELL collateral branch currently shut down.
collateral: WETH, weETH, rswETH, and swETH in overcollateralized Liquity v2-style CDP markets on Swellchain; the configured SWELL branch is currently shut down in live on-chain telemetry
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with Liquity v2-style user-set interest rates and direct on-chain redemption for underlying collateral; Stability Pools absorb liquidations per collateral market

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: USDK is deployed behind an EIP-1967 proxy with Orki AccessManager authority. No active direct blacklist or freeze function was confirmed, but the holder-facing token surface is mutable.

mintAuthority.summary: USDK is minted only when users borrow against overcollateralized CDPs (WETH/weETH/rswETH/swETH) in Orki's exclusive Liquity-v2 fork on Swellchain; mint is fixed to the registered branch contracts and the core is non-upgradeable with no admin-mint or freeze surface.

controls.label: Liquity-v2 BoldToken branch minters (BorrowerOperations/ActivePool/StabilityPool)
controls.evidence: Orki is an exclusive Liquity-v2 fork; per the Liquity-v2 BoldToken design, mint/burn rights are fixed to the registered per-branch protocol contracts and the token is non-upgradeable, so no owner/admin can mint outside CDP borrowing or freeze holders. ORKI governance does not control core minting.

review.evidence: Orki USDK is an exclusive Liquity-v2 (BOLD) fork on Swellchain; minting is user-collateralized CDP borrowing with permissionless redemption, and docs describe a permissionless, non-custodial, no-opaque-governance design. Prior Pharos review confirmed the token has no freeze/blacklist/seizure/proxy-upgrade surface. Renouncement is grounded in the documented immutable Liquity-v2 architecture (mint confined to registered branch contracts, non-upgradeable core), not an independent on-chain owner() read.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm on-chain that BoldToken branch addresses are locked and no owner/setBranchAddresses authority remains active for 0x0000baa0b1678229863c0a941c1056b83a1955f5.
